usage: Feature panel: heading, short paragraphs and a ruled list of arrow links beside a large image that bleeds to the viewport edge.
reuseGuidance: Use for a highlighted topic that links onward. Put the image cell second for image-right (or first for image-left). Set the panel colour with section metadata or design styling.
